findings: Recon Directive exposed Cancel after inspecting cards, incorrectly bottoming both.
Temporary deck-top peeks were not captured by knowledge history; search could forget the known bottom card and Prize exclusions.
resolution: Mandatory Recon Directive selection; record temporary-zone information privately and explicitly refuse unmodeled search. Only a search of the viewer's own deck may infer their Prize identities.
remaining: Bottom-order and partial-peek constraints still need a belief representation; no new training eligibility.
